_note: Per-example metadata for the gallery (ROADMAP Task 314), keyed by file name. Everything a machine CAN derive is derived by dev/scripts/generate_examples.php from the project itself -- node and link counts, unit system, thumbnail -- and is deliberately not repeated here. The card's TITLE and DESCRIPTION are not here either: they live in lib/lang.ec.en.php as lpn_ex_<key>_title and lpn_ex_<key>_desc, because a string outside a lang file is a string no translator will ever see. So this file holds exactly two things a machine cannot work out: which lang keys an example uses, and where it sits on the wall.
_order: Lower sorts earlier. Omit it (0) to let size decide, which is the normal case: the wall runs small to large so a visitor meets the legible networks before Net3. Set it only where size cannot express the intent -- the two basics are the same size, so without it their sequence is whatever the filesystem returned.
